generator.functions: ExecutionIDFor, InputDigest, EncodeTask, EncodeResult, EncodeResultWithCard, EncodeAck, EncodeAckWithCard, EncodeResultRequest, SplitMessage, EncodeFrame, BuildReceipt; every positive case decodes with DecodeTask, DecodeResult, DecodeAck, DecodeResultRequest, DecodeFrame and JoinFrames, and every negative case is refused by them
generator.stand_ins: package bytes and key card bytes are opaque stand-ins: this codec carries them without interpreting them

receipt.note: the Receipt of the result messages; its request is the task_with_card message (source_digest of its 300-byte archive)

negative_frames.name: total_over_kind_bound
negative_frames.rule: total length is within the kind's message bound

negative_frames.name: data_length_mismatch
negative_frames.rule: the data length field equals the bytes that follow

negative_frames.name: truncated_header
negative_frames.rule: a frame has at least 121 bytes

negative_frames.name: trailing_byte
negative_frames.rule: the data length field equals the bytes that follow

negative_frames.name: short_non_final_chunk
negative_frames.rule: every chunk but the last carries 61440 bytes

negative_frames.name: last_chunk_wrong_length
negative_frames.rule: the last chunk carries total - 61440*(count-1) bytes

negative_frames.name: oversized_data
negative_frames.rule: a frame carries at most 61440 data bytes

negative_messages.name: header_length_past_end
negative_messages.rule: the header length is at most the bytes after it

negative_messages.name: task_header_whitespace
negative_messages.rule: the header is the exact canonical JSON

negative_messages.name: task_header_reordered
negative_messages.rule: the header is the exact canonical JSON (field order)

negative_messages.name: task_header_unknown_field
negative_messages.rule: the header has no unknown field

negative_messages.name: task_header_trailing_json
negative_messages.rule: the header is one JSON value

negative_messages.name: task_package_not_strict_base64
negative_messages.rule: package_base64 is strict standard Base64 of non-empty bytes

negative_messages.name: task_empty_card_field
negative_messages.rule: an absent key card is omitted, never empty

negative_messages.name: result_receipt_not_base64
negative_messages.rule: receipt_boc_base64 is strict standard Base64 of non-empty bytes

negative_messages.name: result_request_with_body
negative_messages.rule: a result request has no body

negative_messages.name: result_request_unknown_field
negative_messages.rule: a result request header holds only schema and the optional card

negative_joins.name: mixed_messages
negative_joins.rule: every frame of a set has the same kind, binding, digest, total and count

negative_joins.name: missing_index
negative_joins.rule: every index below count is present

negative_joins.name: digest_mismatch
negative_joins.rule: the joined bytes hash to the message digest
